good_to_know: Every bottle and jar is sealed in its own bag and wrapped in honeycomb paper.
You get a USPS tracking number when your box ships.
Bigger orders ship in more than one box. We'll text you the total first.
Honey ships to California addresses only.
Essential oils and Bee Propolis Tincture are pickup or local delivery only for now: they're flammable, and mailing them takes special handling.
The bitcoin discount applies to products. Shipping is a flat fee.
